title: Til o'rganish strategiyalari so'rovnomasi (SILL, R. L. Oxford, 1990 — 7.0 versiyasi asosida qisqartirilgan va moslashtirilgan)
scale_labels_uz: Hech qachon yoki deyarli hech qachon
Har doim yoki deyarli har doim

memory.name: Xotira strategiyalari
memory.desc: Yangi so'z va tuzilmalarni eslab qolish usullari

cognitive.name: Kognitiv strategiyalar
cognitive.desc: Tilni tahlil qilish, mashq qilish, qayta ishlash

compensation.name: Kompensatsiya strategiyalari
compensation.desc: Bilim yetishmaganda ma'noni topish va muloqotni davom ettirish

items.uz: Yangi inglizcha so'zni eslab qolish uchun uni allaqachon bilgan so'zim bilan bog'layman.
items.en: I think of relationships between what I already know and new things I learn in English.

items.uz: Yangi so'zni gap ichida ishlatib eslab qolaman.
items.en: I use new English words in a sentence so I can remember them.

items.uz: Yangi so'zning tovushi va uning obrazi yoki rasmini bog'lab eslayman.
items.en: I connect the sound of a new English word and an image or picture of the word to help me remember it.

items.uz: Yangi so'zlarni muntazam takrorlab turaman.
items.en: I review English lessons often.

items.uz: Yangi so'zni bir necha marta aytib yoki yozib ko'raman.
items.en: I say or write new English words several times.

items.uz: Ingliz tilida ma'ruza, podkast yoki video tomosha qilaman.
items.en: I watch English language TV shows or listen to English audio.

items.uz: Inglizcha matnni avval tez ko'zdan kechirib, keyin diqqat bilan o'qiyman.
items.en: I first skim an English passage, then go back and read carefully.

items.uz: So'zma-so'z tarjima qilmaslikka harakat qilaman.
items.en: I try not to translate word-for-word.

items.uz: Notanish so'zni ma'nosini kontekstdan taxmin qilaman.
items.en: To understand unfamiliar English words, I make guesses.

items.uz: Suhbatda so'z topolmasam, imo-ishora yoki boshqa so'z bilan tushuntiraman.
items.en: When I can't think of a word during a conversation in English, I use gestures or a synonym.

items.uz: Har bir yangi so'zni lug'atdan qaramasdan o'qishni davom ettiraman.
items.en: I read English without looking up every new word.

items.uz: Suhbatdoshim nima deyishini oldindan taxmin qilishga harakat qilaman.
items.en: I try to guess what the other person will say next in English.

items.uz: Ingliz tilini qo'llash uchun imkon qadar ko'proq imkoniyat izlayman.
items.en: I try to find as many ways as I can to use my English.

items.uz: Xatolarimni sezaman va ulardan yaxshiroq ishlash uchun foydalanaman.
items.en: I notice my English mistakes and use that information to help me do better.

items.uz: O'rganish uchun aniq maqsad qo'yaman va jadval tuzaman.
items.en: I plan my schedule so I will have enough time to study English and set clear goals.

items.uz: Ingliz tilini o'rganishdagi yutuqlarimni muntazam baholab boraman.
items.en: I think about my progress in learning English.

items.uz: Ingliz tilida gapirishdan qo'rqsam ham, o'zimni xotirjam qilishga harakat qilaman.
items.en: I try to relax whenever I feel afraid of using English.

items.uz: Xato qilishdan qo'rqmasdan gapirishga o'zimni undayman.
items.en: I encourage myself to speak English even when I am afraid of making a mistake.

items.uz: Yaxshi natijaga erishganimda o'zimni rag'batlantiraman.
items.en: I give myself a reward when I do well in English.

items.uz: Til o'rganishdagi his-tuyg'ularimni boshqalar bilan muhokama qilaman yoki kundalikka yozaman.
items.en: I talk to someone else or write in a diary about how I feel when I am learning English.

items.uz: Tushunmasam, suhbatdoshimdan sekinroq gapirishni yoki takrorlashni so'rayman.
items.en: If I do not understand something in English, I ask the other person to slow down or say it again.

items.uz: Ingliz tilida gapirganimda tuzatishlarini so'rayman.
items.en: I ask English speakers to correct me when I talk.

items.uz: Guruhdoshlarim bilan ingliz tilida mashq qilaman.
items.en: I practise English with other students.

items.uz: Ingliz tilida so'zlashuvchilarning madaniyatini o'rganishga harakat qilaman.
items.en: I try to learn about the culture of English speakers.
